mapper.select: SELECT a.id, a.user_id AS userId, a.bank_code AS bankCode, a.account_number AS accountNumber, a.status FROM accounts a WHERE a.user_id = #{userId} AND a.status = 'ACTIVE' LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO account_histories ( account_id, trace_id, transaction_type, amount, status, failure_code ) VALUES ( #{accountId}, #{traceId}, 'WITHDRAWAL', #{amount}, 'SUCCESS', NULL )
